digest.component_or_area: code-review gate, plan-review gate, completion verifier
propositions: The code-review gate has five LLM-calling steps (base, round_a, round_b, verify, coach) but only verify declares a model class; the remaining four steps inherit cfg.model implicitly, preventing per-pass model selection on non-default providers.

On a Bedrock configuration, an operator cannot express that Pass-1 finders should use frontier (opus-family) while Pass-2/Pass-4 verifiers should use standard (sonnet-family) because all undeclared steps resolve to a single cfg.model value.

Step-level model declarations on batch steps (round_a, round_b) are silent no-ops because the batch runner reads only the model_ladder from inside the batch sub-dict, never the enclosing step's model key.
The verifier downgrade that applies sonnet to Pass-2/Pass-4 is skipped on non-default providers due to an equality test conflating provider change with explicit operator override.
No test asserts that per-step model declarations are actually resolved and passed to the runner at execution time, only that the YAML contains the token and class resolution works in isolation.
